Good solid little cart, use it with my 22” blackstone. It’s a little cumbersome to fold up but I don’t plan on using it portably so it doesn’t really affect me. It’s a bit tight with a 20lb propane tank but it works. Overall happy with it

I purchased a Blackstone table top unit a while back. I recently wanted something that I could use to move the Blackstone to different places or even to tailgate. I found this outdoor grill cart on Vevor. It arrived quickly, was easy to assemble (less than 20 minutes), and is the perfect size for my griddle. It has places to hang grilling utensils and sauces/seasonings, as well as a holder for the propane tank. So far I have nothing but good experiences from the purchase and product.

Works great. Use my Weber grill with a propane tank. Holds tank and grill perfectly. Extra room to hold other stuff like paper towels, bbq sauce, bbq tools, etc. mobility is great too. Important for me as I store in she’d.
